paite: TOUPA aw, kei lam ah na bil hon doh inla, hon dawng in; genthei leh tagah lua ka hi.
heading: David thumna / Panpihna Dia Thumna
english: A Prayer by David. Hear, Yahweh, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

paite: Ka hinna vomhoih inla; Pathian limsakmi ka hi ngal a, ka Pathian aw, nangmah muang na sikha, hondam in.
english: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.

paite: TOUPA aw, hon hehpih inla; nitum in ka hon sam ngal a.
english: Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.

paite: Na sikha hinna hihnuam in; TOUPA aw, ka lungsim na kiang ah ka koihdet ziak in.
english: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.

paite: TOUPA, nang, na hoih a, ngaihdam na ngap a, ahon sam peuhmah tung ah zahngaihna na hau ngal hi.
english: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka thumna ah na bil na doh in; hehpih ka hon ngetna aw ngaikhia in.
english: Hear, Yahweh, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.

paite: Ka mangbat ni in ka hon sam ding a, huchi in na hon dawng ding hi.
english: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.

paite: TOUPA aw, pathiante lak ah nang bang himhim a-om kei ua; na thilhih bang thilhih a-om kei hi.
english: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.

paite: TOUPA aw, na siam nam chihte ahong pai ding ua, na ma ah akun ding ua, na min ahon pahtawi ding uhi.
english: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.

paite: Nang na thupi ngala, thillamdangte leng na hih zel a; nangmah kia Pathian na hi.
english: For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.

paite: TOUPA aw, na lampi hon ensak inla, na thutak ah ka om ding a, na min lau ding in lungtang khat hon pusak in.
english: Teach me your way, Yahweh. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.

paite: TOUPA ka Pathian aw, ka lungtang tengteng in ka hon phat ding a; na min tangtawn in ka pahtawi ding hi.
english: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.

paite: Ka tung a na zahngaihna athupi ziak in, ka hinna kokhuk nuainungpen a kipan na humbitta hi.
english: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.

paite: Pathian aw, mikisatheite'n hon sual ua, mingongtat omkhawmte'n ka hinna hihmang tum in azong ua, nang ama uah ahon koih kei uhi.
english: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don’t hold regard for you before them.

paite: Himahleh, TOUPA aw, nang Pathian, lainatna a dim, mihehpih thei, lungnel, zahngaihna leh thutak hau na hi.
english: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.

paite: Kei lam hong nga inla, aw, ka tung ah zahngai in, na sikha kiang ah na hatna pia inla, na sikhanu tapa hondam in.
english: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant.

paite: Hoihna ding chiamtehna hon lak in; hon hote'n huai amuh ua, azahlakna ding un, TOUPA, nang na hon panpih a, na hon khamuan ziak in.
english: Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, Yahweh, have helped me, and comforted me.
